reasons: CS2103T and ST2334 cannot be in the same semester: CS2103T is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2, while ST2334 is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2, but the student requires them in Sem 4 which is an even semester (Sem 2 of AY2). Wait, Sem 4 is even, so it is Sem 2. Both are offered in Sem 2. However, CS2103T prerequisite is (CS2030... and CS2040...). ST2334 prerequisite is MA1521 (completed). The conflict is that CS2103T requires CS2030S and CS2040S/C/etc. The student must take CS2030S. CS2030S prerequisite is CS1101S (completed). So CS2030S can be taken in Sem 2 (Sem 2 of Y1, i.e., Sem 2) or later. If CS2103T is in Sem 4, CS2030S must be in Sem 2 or 3. CS2040S requires CS1231S (completed) and CS1101S (completed). So CS2040S can be in Sem 2 or 3. If CS2030S and CS2040S are in Sem 3, CS2103T can be in Sem 4. This is valid. The constraint 'CS2103T and ST2334 must be in the same semester' forces ST2334 to Sem 4. But the student also said 'ST2334 has to be in semester 3'. This is a direct contradiction. ST2334 cannot be in both Sem 3 and Sem 4.
